property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, transfer(...) either reverts or returns true; if it returns true then it must have made all external calls to caddress succeed (i.e., none of the individual calls reverted).
If transfer is called with an empty _tos array it must revert; otherwise if it returns (no revert) it must return true.
For any non-empty _tos and any inputs, transfer either reverts or returns true (i.e., it cannot return false) — and when _tos is non-empty the call must not return false.
For any non-empty _tos and any inputs, transfer either reverts or returns true; if it returns true then address(c) balance does not decrease (no Ether is forwarded by C during transfer).
